human_design.role: interpretive perspective on operating patterns and conditions

iching_tarot.role: symbolic projection and reflection interface that exposes current narrative, meaning weights and possible questions

sandtray.role: externalise people, relationships, resources, distance and blockage for spatial reconstruction and scenario simulation

guided_consciousness_exploration.role: observe inner narrative, symbols, memories, emotions and self-model material through deep guided attention

angelic_reiki.role: ritualised space for quiet attention, body-sensation observation and restorative experience

financial_planning.role: reconstruct cash flow, assets, liabilities, protection, goals and resource constraints into Financial Runtime

insurance_planning.role: read income dependency, family responsibility, health risk, liquidity and protection gaps as Protection Runtime

investment_planning.role: navigate capital allocation from goals, horizon, liquidity, risk capacity, existing allocation and concentration

integrationRules: Observed evidence, professional assessment, symbolic material and subjective experience must remain separately labelled.
No modality can retroactively prove its own interpretation.
A symbolic or subjective output may create a question or review signal, not an objective fact.
Financial product-specific action requires a separate regulated gate and human client decision.
Integrated reports must show source, modality, confidence, limitation and confirmation status for every material statement.
